title: FilterBar
wrapsNative: searchable(text:prompt:) on a List in a NavigationStack, safeAreaInset(edge: .top) with a horizontal ScrollView of MonarchTag chips (isSelected for quick filters, onRemove for active ones), a toolbar Button that opens MonarchFacetedFilterPanel in a sheet with presentationDetents, and a Menu with a Picker for sorting
summary: A recipe, not a component: search in the navigation bar, a row of filter chips above the list (quick toggles and removable active filters, with Clear all), and the full filter set in a sheet.
whenToUse: Above any filterable list of records (tickets, orders, people), where people narrow results by status, owner or other fields.
whenNotToUse: For a handful of fixed views use a segmented Picker or MonarchSavedViews. For building conditions with operators use MonarchQueryBuilder. For search across the whole app use the command palette recipe.
api: NavigationStack { List { … }.searchable(text:prompt:).safeAreaInset(edge: .top) { ScrollView(.horizontal) { HStack { MonarchTag(_:isSelected:); MonarchTag(_:removeLabel:onRemove:); Button("Clear all") } } }.toolbar { Button("Filters (n)", systemImage:) } }
Menu { Picker("Sort by", selection:) { … } } label: { Label("Sort", systemImage: "arrow.up.arrow.down") } for sorting and display options

states.name: no filters
states.description: Only quick-filter chips; the toolbar button reads "Filters".

states.name: active filters
states.description: A removable chip per active value, Clear all, and "Filters (2)" on the toolbar button.

states.name: quick filter on
states.description: A selected MonarchTag, read as selected, with a check.

states.name: editing
states.description: The sheet with MonarchFacetedFilterPanel; the list updates as boxes are ticked.

states.name: no results
states.description: Show MonarchEmptyState with kind .filtered and onClearFilters in place of the list.

appearance: The system navigation bar search field, Monarch tags in the neutral tone (filled when selected), ghost Monarch buttons, and the facet panel in a sheet. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web FilterBar is one component: a search input on the leading edge, FilterChips with popover editors, an Add filter menu, Clear all, a result count and trailing controls, which below a width move into a bottom sheet behind a "Filters (n)" button. On a phone that narrow layout is the only one, so iOS composes it: search moves into the navigation bar with searchable, chips scroll sideways in the top safe-area inset, and editing a filter happens in the sheet with MonarchFacetedFilterPanel instead of a popover per chip. readFilterParams and writeFilterParams (URL query strings) have no counterpart; persist filters with the app's own state, such as SceneStorage. Android composes the same recipe.
accessibility: The search field is the system's, named by its prompt.
Quick filters are MonarchTag toggles read with their selected state; active filters are tags with a remove button named "Remove Status filter".
The toolbar button includes the number of active filters in its name.
Announce the result count when it changes (AccessibilityNotification.Announcement), as the web's live region does.
Every chip and button is at least 44 points.
edgeCases: Many chips scroll sideways; keep Clear all at the end of the row so it is reached last.
Removing the last value of a facet removes the facet from the selection.
A sheet with detents keeps the list visible behind it at the medium height.
